instruction: Find papers on Huggingface from March 1st, 2024 and add 3 more papers with their arxiv.org PDF links to the document. The document currently has 2 papers. Make sure all PDF links point to arxiv.org.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click(640, 400); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding 3 more papers with arxiv.org PDF links to the existing 2, totaling 5 PDF links. The evaluator extracts all arxiv URLs and checks that at least 5 URLs contain 'arxiv.org'. Partial credit awarded: full score if all URLs are valid, proportional score otherwise. Verified by reading the initial document which contains 2 papers with arxiv.org links.
